verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm Fly.io runs a status page, including an organization-level one. Users say it showed everything green or 'no incidents' during real outages, and no first-party docs describe a public status page or a historical incident archive. The only incident explanation in the pack is an ad-hoc staff reply on Hacker News, not a published postmortem. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a public status page, a historical incident history, published postmortems, and independent corroboration that the page reflects incidents accurately.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can check a public status page with historical incident postmortems before committing

citations.quote: their status page will show everything green
